say:3:1741129003:1.text: Every day in the Twilight Pavilion, people make deals no one else ever hears about.

say:9:1741129008:1.text: A fallen noble once traded his family's old treasure map for a clue about his missing fiancée.

say:9:1741129008:1.female: A fallen noble once traded his family's old treasure map for a clue about his missing fiancée.

say:10:1741129009:1.text: Everyone called him a fool. They thought he had thrown away his family's last hope for one woman.

say:14:1741129013:1.text: A boy once paid me with a secret to find the thief who killed his parents. That thief happened to have the same name as the treasure hunter.
